title: Formulation and Learning Of The Forecasting Problem
abstract: arXiv:2603.20359v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine learning has opened new frontiers in purely data-driven forecasting of dynamical systems; the resulting methods are showing considerable promise in some application domains. However, in contrast to model-driven algorithms, analysis of these data-driven methods is poorly developed. In this paper we address this issue, developing a theory to underpin data-driven methods to solve forecasting problems. The theoretical framework comprises two key components: (i) establishing the existence of a mapping defining the forecasting problem; (ii) showing that it is possible to approximate this mapping by supervised learning techniques, to arbitrary accuracy. We work in the continuous-time and noise-free setting as this defines a simple canonical setting in which to establish an underpinning theory; the continuous-time setting leads to an operator formulation of the problem in which the underlying forecasting map is defined on pathspace.

translated_title: 预测问题的构建与学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.20359v3 公告类型： replace 摘要： 机器学习为纯粹数据驱动的动力系统预测开辟了新的前沿，由此产生的方法在一些应用领域展现出可观的前景。然而，与模型驱动算法相比，对这些数据驱动方法的理论分析发展尚不充分。本文针对这一问题，发展了一套理论来支撑求解预测问题的数据驱动方法。该理论框架包含两个关键部分：(i) 确立定义预测问题的映射的存在性；(ii) 证明该映射可以通过监督学习技术以任意精度进行逼近。我们在连续时间且无噪声的设定下开展工作，因为该设定提供了一个简单的规范化环境，便于建立基础理论；连续时间设定使得该问题具有算子化的表述形式，其中底层的预测映射定义在路径空间上。
tldr: 本文为数据驱动的动力系统预测方法建立了理论基础，证明了定义预测问题的映射的存在性，并证明该映射可通过监督学习以任意精度逼近。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a theoretical foundation for data-driven forecasting of dynamical systems by proving the existence of the mapping that defines the forecasting problem and demonstrating that it can be approximated to arbitrary accuracy via supervised learning.
